name: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Ltd
tagline: Specialty bimetal/thermal-fuse component maker with strong ROCE/ROE, but valuation has run far ahead of profitability after a +93% one-year rally
business_overview: Shivalik Bimetal Controls (SBCL) manufactures specialty bimetal strips, thermal fuses, and precision electrical/electronic components, shifting strategically toward higher-value components per recent earnings commentary.
fundamentals_table: FY26 revenue +12.3% to Rs 570.9 Cr; PAT +24.8% to Rs 95.8 Cr
fundamentals_narrative: Genuinely strong quality metrics — ROCE 22.3%, ROE 24.68%, PAT growth (24.8%) outpacing revenue growth (12.3%), and very low leverage. But the market cap has nearly doubled (+93.4%) over the past year while sales grew only ~12%, pushing valuation to roughly 9-12x sales/book — a large re-rating that has outrun the underlying growth.
